label: Strictness separator for the box K projection, checked
description: On a two-point model where both candidates are actual roots (concrete, existing at the one self-accessing world, grounded by nothing) and only one is GOD_4, with every supplied attribute predicate chosen so that its attribute holds, the box K node holds (witness: the GOD_4 candidate) and the classical GOD_4 root fails. The failure is located: on this model the classical root is equivalent to some candidate satisfying every other conjunct of its body and being the only actual root; the GOD_4 candidate satisfies every other conjunct, and the other candidate is a second actual root that is not GOD_4. So only the selected-root uniqueness conjunct of PerfectRootAt fails, while the box K node's IsTheOneGod (uniqueness among GOD_4 bearers) does not exclude a second, non-GOD_4 actual root. Non-degenerate: no supplied predicate is emptied, and the failing conjunct uses ActualRoot, which both nodes contain. It replaces a draft separator that failed only by emptying HasIntellect, a free parameter the box K node does not mention. Other content differences are not model-separated here. Model-witnessed only; a statement about this formal interpretation.
